At UiPath, we're helping shape this future by creating products that are powerful, intuitive, and grounded in real customer needs. As a Senior Product Designer in UiPath's Supply Chain & Retail solutions team (formerly Peak AI), you'll help drive our latest agentic solutions. You'll shape how customers understand, trust, and adopt agent-driven workflows, translating complex operational reality into clear, dependable experiences that deliver measurable impact. Zero-copy integrations are becoming a core pattern for this world. The goal is not just connectivity. You will help Snowflake define and execute this strategy across key partners and platforms.
